why_us.heading: Why Work With Us?
why_us.description:
At TSV Global Solutions, we believe that exceptional logistics starts with exceptional people. We offer a collaborative environment where your ideas are heard, your growth is supported, and your contribution makes a real global impact.

With offices in Chennai and Navi Mumbai, and operations spanning 150+ countries, a career at TSV Global means working on complex, meaningful logistics challenges every day.

jobs.title: Freight Operations Executive
jobs.description: Manage day-to-day freight operations including FCL/LCL shipment coordination, carrier bookings, and documentation compliance.

jobs.title: Customs Clearance Officer
jobs.description: Handle import/export customs documentation, BOE filing, duty assessment, and coordination with CBIC for smooth clearance.

jobs.title: Customer Service Executive
jobs.description: Be the key POC for clients, providing real-time shipment updates, resolving queries, and coordinating with operations for seamless delivery.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Freight
jobs.description: Drive business development in air & ocean freight, build client relationships, manage key accounts, and exceed revenue targets.
